title_en: He eats, she does not eat

lines.en: Last night the warrior arrived from a foreign land,
He brought a foreign girl with him
No mother has given birth to a more beautiful girl.

lines.cyr: - Мори слези да би ми не слегла,
lines.lat: - Mori slezi da bi mi ne slegla,
lines.en: - You come down or stay there forever,
You speak or go mute forever,

lines.cyr: мори јади да се не најадиш!
lines.lat: mori jadi da se ne najadiš!
lines.en: You eat or be hungry forever!

lines.cyr: Дали ми те куќа не бендиса,
lines.lat: Dali mi te kuḱa ne bendisa,
lines.en: Is it because you don’t like the house,

lines.cyr: дали ми те момче не ареса,
lines.lat: dali mi te momče ne aresa,
lines.en: Is it because you don’t like your husband,

lines.cyr: дали ми те свекор не ареса?
lines.lat: dali mi te svekor ne aresa?
lines.en: Is because you don’t like your father-in-law?
He comes down, she does not come down,
He speaks, she does not speak,

lines.cyr: тој се смеит, таа не се смеит,
lines.lat: toj se smeit, taa ne se smeit,
lines.en: He laughs, she does not laugh,
He eats, she does not eat.
